name: Tomaru Shin'ichi
source:
A third year student and treasurer of the student council. He always handles business with a relaxed atmosphere. He has the unpleasant duty of breaking up Itsuki and Kyouko's fights. 

[Based on [url=http://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/初恋サクラメント]Wikipedia[/url]]
